Name: Slime livestock and potion brewing
Author: vanilliaether
Description:
-1.1.5 updates adds-
15 new slime colors
new slime brewer image
new potion images(thanks [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/52012881-sonreirblah/]sonreirblah[/url] for the potion sprites)

-Installation Instructions-
extract zip file into your stardew valley mods folder
read instructions in Slime and Potion Brewing/[BFAV] Slime/Instructions - IMPORTANT.txt


-adds slime livestock into game
slime are milked for slime juice which is used for potion making
adds new machine called potion brewer and greater potion brewer
potion brewer will use slime juice and another item to create a potion

EXTRA INFO

-Machines-
Potion Brewer
Greater Potion Brewer

-Slimes-
Cost: 5000
Big Coop and Deluxe Coop

-Potion Brewer Potions-
Slime Juice And ...
Potion of Luck -> Rabbits Foot
Potion of Healing - > Any Mushroom
Potion of friendship -> Strawberries
Potion of Fishing -> Any Fish
Potion of Mining -> Gold(2), Iron(3), Copper ore(4)
Potion of Farming-> Beans, Tomatoes,Grapes ,Cactus Fruit
Potion of Speed-> Coffee, Coffee Beans
Potion of Magnetism-> Any Geods

-Greater Potion Brewer Potions-
Large Slime Juice and ...
Potion of Greater Luck -> Rabbits Foot
Potion of Greater Healing - > Any Mushroom
Potion of friendship -> Strawberries
Potion of Greater Fishing -> Any Fish
Potion of Greater Mining -> Gold(2), Iron(3), Copper ore(4)
Potion of Greater Farming-> Beans, Tomatoes,Grapes ,Cactus Fruit
Potion of Greater Speed-> Coffee, Coffee Beans
Potion of Greater Magnetism-> Any Geods

-Price-
all normal potions are currently worth 500
all greater potions are all currently worth 1000
this will most likely be balanced in the future
